entries.name: Academic Writing
entries.description: Plan, critique and draft essays, lab reports, literature reviews and short answers from a student's argument, data and sources. Use clear, direct prose while preserving technical precision and evidence. Use when a student wants help structuring, drafting, citing or revising academic writing, building a claim-source evidence matrix or reviewing a specific writing concern.

entries.name: PDF
entries.description: Read, extract, split, merge, fill, rotate and OCR PDF files. Useful alongside exam-prep when a student has a past paper as a scanned PDF rather than as text.

steps: Clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills or download the skills/pdf directory.
Copy skills/pdf into your agent's skills directory (~/.claude/skills/pdf for Claude Code).
Install its Python dependencies: pip install pypdf pdfplumber.
Start a new session and ask your agent to work with a PDF.

accesses: PDF files you point it at
your local shell, to run Python PDF tooling

entries.name: Exam Prep
entries.description: Build practice question sets from a course, module or topic, mark a student's answers, diagnose which topics are weak, and plan revision against an exam date. Use when a student wants to practise, be quizzed, sit a mock paper, check answers, update revision checkpoints or plan practice sessions. Use syllabus-map for a complete syllabus and past-question checklist. Use last-minute-revision for a compact night-before revision sheet.

entries.name: Flashcard Builder
entries.description: Build spaced-repetition flashcards from a course, topic, or a student's own draft cards. Critiques student-drafted cards for cloze quality and one-fact-per-card discipline, or generates a full deck with an Anki export and a review schedule. Use when a student wants flashcards, wants their flashcards checked, wants an Anki deck, or wants a spaced-repetition schedule.

entries.name: Last Minute Revision
entries.description: Turn a syllabus and past papers into a compact nested revision checklist with asked-topic evidence, explicit OOS portions and a realistic time budget. Adapt to revision checkpoints and full, two-hour or 15-minute views. Use for last-minute revision, a night-before overview, a crash sheet or a quick version of a syllabus map. Use syllabus-map for the detailed coverage audit and exam-prep for interactive questions or mock papers.

entries.name: Syllabus Map
entries.description: Build a complete nested checklist of syllabus modules, topics and subtopics. Map past-paper questions to each topic with paper references and marks, recurring question patterns and revision checkpoints. Compare syllabus versions and mark confirmed OOS portions. Use for a detailed syllabus breakdown, coverage audit, version comparison or list of everything asked. Use last-minute-revision for a compact revision version.
